title: Fixation-hold with Peripheral Flash
summary: A fixation-hold task in which a brief peripheral flash is presented on half of the trials, either to the left or right of fixation. The subject must maintain fixation throughout. The experiment measures the rate and latency of fixation breaks on flash versus no-flash trials.
paradigm: Each trial begins with a fixation point at screen center. The subject must acquire and hold fixation. On flash trials, a brief peripheral flash appears either 8 dva left or right of fixation. On no-flash trials, no flash is shown. The subject is instructed to maintain fixation throughout. The trial ends if fixation is broken or after a set hold duration. Conditions (flash left, flash right, no flash) are served equally, in sequence or shuffled as set in paradigm.kind.

design.label: Conditions
design.value: Flash left, Flash right, No flash

design.label: Session length
design.value: 5–15 minutes for humans, depending on n_per_condition and subject pace

stimuli.name: fixation
stimuli.notes: White filled circle at screen center, size set by fix_size_dva.

stimuli.name: flash_left
stimuli.notes: Yellow filled circle, appears 8 dva left of fixation on flash-left trials, size set by flash_size_dva.

stimuli.name: flash_right
stimuli.notes: Yellow filled circle, appears 8 dva right of fixation on flash-right trials, size set by flash_size_dva.

measures.definition: Whether fixation was broken during or after the flash (on flash trials) or during the equivalent period (no-flash trials)
measures.name: fixation_break

measures.definition: Latency from flash onset to fixation break, or null if no break
measures.name: break_latency_ms

measures.definition: Condition label: flash left, flash right, or no flash
measures.name: condition

measures.definition: Outcome of the trial: FIXATED, FIX_BREAK, NO_FIXATION
measures.name: outcome

parameters.label: Fixation point size
parameters.meaning: Diameter of the fixation point at screen center
parameters.name: fix_size_dva

parameters.label: Fixation window diameter
parameters.meaning: Diameter of the gaze window for fixation acquisition and hold
parameters.name: fix_window_dva

parameters.label: Fixation acquire timeout
parameters.meaning: Maximum time to acquire fixation before aborting the trial
parameters.name: acquire_timeout

parameters.label: Fixation hold duration
parameters.meaning: Duration for which fixation must be held (including flash period)
parameters.name: hold_duration

constraints.note: Conventional value for a brief visual flash

parameters.label: Flash eccentricity
parameters.meaning: Horizontal distance from fixation to flash center
parameters.name: flash_eccentricity_dva

constraints.note: Conventional value for a small peripheral flash

parameters.label: Trials per condition
parameters.meaning: How many times each condition is served
parameters.name: paradigm.n_per_condition

timeline.note: Wait for gaze to enter fixation window, up to acquire_timeout.
timeline.until: Gaze enters fixation window or timeout

timeline.note: Hold fixation for hold_duration. On flash trials, flash appears after flash_onset_delay (default 250 ms) for flash_duration.
Present peripheral flash for flash_duration on flash trials. On no-flash trials, nothing is shown.
Mark outcome: FIXATED if fixation held, FIX_BREAK if fixation broken, NO_FIXATION if never acquired.

tasks.description: Fixation-hold with peripheral flash: subject maintains fixation while a brief flash appears left or right (or not at all). Measures fixation stability and break latency.
tasks.name: fixation-flash

tests.how: Load all parameters and check that each is present and valid.
tests.name: Parameter load

tests.how: Run a simulated session with all three conditions and verify that the timeline and outcomes are as expected.
tests.name: Simulated session

tests.how: Check that the timeline includes fixation acquire, hold, flash (on flash trials), and outcome phases in the correct order.
tests.name: Timeline structure

tests.how: Verify that each condition (flash left, flash right, no flash) is served paradigm.n_per_condition times.
tests.name: Condition counts

tests.how: Simulate a trial with a fixation break after the flash and check that break_latency_ms is recorded.
tests.name: Fixation break latency

notes: Chose flash duration (flash_duration.ms=50), flash size (flash_size_dva=1.0), and flash eccentricity (flash_eccentricity_dva=8.0) as conventional values. Chose fixation hold duration (hold_duration.ms=500) and acquire timeout (acquire_timeout.ms=2000) as in the scaffold. Chose inter-trial interval (iti.ms=500) as in the scaffold. Chose white for fixation color and yellow for flash color. Chose sequence scheduler as default.
